title: Refreeze candidate after Metal and Windows repairs
requires: Green exact-source protected CI and accepted F8-73 macOS Metal development repair evidence
Accepted F8-75/F8-76 Windows CUDA ownership/fixture repairs and F8-77 completion waiting
Complete F8-78 integrated Windows correctness/work/recovery evidence with every timing failure classified
scope: Freeze one immutable sole-path integration candidate containing the accepted Metal, shared Gallery, Windows ownership/fixture and completion-wait repairs. Apply the 2026-11-03 timing deferral in docs/roadmap/PHYSICS-QUALITY-DEVELOPMENT.md. Include exact source/tree, manifest, complete protected closure, binaries/deployments, runtime variants, toolchains and green exact-source CI. Route every unfinished physical qualification row to the replacement and add bounded replacement-candidate requalification leaves for completed rows. Classify all capture failures before acceptance. Timing-only misses are recorded for F9-07/F9-08. Correctness, physical assertions, resource recovery and independent work budgets remain required. Preserve candidate-v9 and earlier observations as immutable history.
acceptance: A new immutable candidate manifest records the exact repaired source/tree, public API/ABI, shared Slang kernels, adapter binding, runtime, schedule/telemetry, public oracle, work budgets and shared Gallery closure with all 49 capabilities, 30 public cases, 12 scenarios and 37 measurements.

Independent generation/checking agrees on every protected closure. Exact-source protected CI passes. F8-73 supplies accepted physical macOS Metal registered, installed-public, validation and Gallery lifecycle evidence. Record all sustained timings and their source identity under the timing-deferral policy.
Candidate v9 manifest and F8-28 failure evidence remain byte-immutable. No partial v9 pass, earlier candidate pass or repaired-source observation is relabeled as replacement-candidate qualification.

A coordination-only change binds F8-27 through F8-30 and every other unfinished row to the replacement candidate, and adds replacement leaves for completed candidate-v9 CPU, CUDA and Vulkan rows plus the in-flight F8-26 result as required. No row becomes ready against an invalid candidate.

Every device can reproduce the replacement capture from documented installed-public commands without changing physics, capabilities, cases, schedules, budgets, tolerances or required timeouts. Any later protected change creates another candidate rather than mutating this freeze.

Exact-source Windows evidence for the integrated F8-75/F8-76/F8-77/F8-78 repair passes the registered suite, installed SDK/Gallery requirements and installed-public physical/work/recovery checks under normal asynchronous execution. All five desktop workloads and five canonical negative controls are retained in both modes at unchanged counts, 600 warmup and 7200 measured ticks. Classify each failed assertion. Timing-only misses and timing-contaminated negative-control baselines are disclosed F9 debt. Preserve original validator results and candidate-v9 failure evidence, and bind F8-26 to the new candidate before its claim.

Publish separate F8 integration/correctness and final-performance verdicts for the candidate. Document the original 10 ms physics p95, 16.666666666666668 ms frame p95 and 0.99 simulated/wall targets as F9-07/F9-08 obligations. Any executable reporting-policy change requires its own bounded task and merged lease before implementation.
